f = current_frame
before_lines = f.ascii.split('\n')

after_lines = after.ascii.split('\n')

changed = []

                changed.append((r, c, before_lines[r][c], after_lines[r][c]))

    print(f"  ({r},{c}): {b} -> {a}")

# Show col 42-45 for all rows
print("\nCol 42-45 after:")
for r in range(12, 42):
    print(f"  row {r}: {after_lines[r][42:46]}")

# Show rows 18-30, cols 11-47
print("\nRows 18-30, cols 11-47:")
